session_1.speaker: Alice
session_1.text: I finally sold the old estate car.

session_1.speaker: Bob
session_1.text: About time. What did you replace it with?

session_2.speaker: Bob
session_2.text: How is the hatchback holding up?

session_2.speaker: Alice
session_2.text: Needed new brakes already, cost me two hundred.

qa.question: How long after buying the car did Alice pay for repairs?
Why did Alice sell the estate car and buy the hatchback?
qa.answer: She wanted something smaller and cheaper to run.

qa.question: Is a hatchback smaller than an estate car?
qa.answer: Yes, which is why Alice downsized.
